title: Qinglan Hospital New Wing Equipment Tender Status Report

passages.text: The bid deadline for the Qinglan Hospital new wing equipment tender is 5 p.m. on December 15, 2026. Sales manager Wenyan Hsu leads the tender, assisted by sales representative Jiarong Lin.
The tender covers 60 Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitors and 40 IP-300 Infusion Pumps; the bid documents are about 70% complete, and the manufacturer authorization letter was received on October 16.
The planned bid amount for the Qinglan new wing tender is NT$7,250,000, an average discount of about 8%, approved by the General Manager.
